sourceWitness.text: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

identityBasisJa: 固定WEB JOS17:1は前半で「マナセ族」のくじを記し、続けて「彼はヨセフの長子」と族祖個人マナセを明示する。部族profileの集団言及とは別の同一ID contextとして分ける。
decision: propose separate personal context; collective base retains the tribe clause only
